sports.name: Baseball
sports.summary: From first swings to league baseball.
programs: An introduction to hitting and fielding with a batting tee and on-field coaching.
Coach-pitched batting and instruction to help young players develop their skills.
A transition toward player pitching, supported by coaches under league rules.
Additional pathways include Parkland Youth League, Lehigh Valley League, Connie Mack and Senior Legion.

sports.name: Basketball
sports.summary: Skill development and teamwork on the court.
programs: Team play and opportunities to develop basketball skills.
A competitive pathway described in the association’s program overview. Contact the commissioner about selection and eligibility.

sports.name: Cheer
programs: Grade-based cheer groups support participation and team spirit.
The program includes Flags, Junior Pee Wee, Pee Wee, Junior Varsity and Varsity groups. Placement depends on the season’s requirements and participation.

sports.name: Field Hockey
programs: A recreational program with evaluations to help create evenly matched teams.

sports.name: Football
programs: An introductory flag division within the football program, separate from NFL Flag.
Junior Pee Wee, Pee Wee, Junior Varsity and Varsity divisions have specific age and weight requirements.

sports.name: Lacrosse
programs: An introductory program that teaches lacrosse basics through play.
Grade-based team programs with age-appropriate skill development.
Ask about loan equipment, required personal equipment and uniform purchases before registering.

sports.name: NFL Flag
programs: A community-focused flag football program for a range of skill levels.
The program lists 7U, 9U, 11U, 13U and 15U divisions. Eligibility cutoffs vary by season.
NFL Flag is separate from the flag division within SPYA Football.

sports.name: Soccer
programs: Opportunities to develop skills and enjoy team play.
A separate pathway with tryouts and a season commitment. Ask about current requirements.

sports.name: Softball
programs: The program typically fields 8U, 10U and 12U teams. A 14U team depends on interest.
Practices and home games are held at Springhouse Middle School, 1200 Springhouse Road, Allentown.
